svg.text: 4 IDs × 8 bits = 32 bits, instead of 8 × 32 = 256 bits (8x smaller). Drawn

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with 8 centroids; real PQ uses 256 (one byte) or 16 (FastScan).

svg.text: For each query, compute once its distance to every centroid of every

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sub-space. The distance to any stored vector is then 4 table lookups added

svg.text: Unlike TurboQuant, the codebooks are learned from the data: training comes first and must be repeated when the data drifts.
